protocol.threshold_semantics: Strict absolute P(TP before SL by horizon)>p. No-touch is not a win.
protocol.forecast_anchor: Last completed close, fixed absolute TP/SL. M1 OPEN one minute after decision is execution proxy; execution repricing checks entry is inside fixed levels and target reward covers costs.
protocol.eligibility: 10080 contiguous completed M1 history; last24h of each role purged from entry decisions. No future outcome eligibility filter.
protocol.interval_selection: Longest common gap-free candle interval in each role, timestamps only before inference or outcomes. Full test separately censored when path unknown.
protocol.account: Cash-funded long spot only, one position per asset, max15% allocation, .5% equity risk, $1 min notional, shared cash. Existing barrier_only simulator.
protocol.selection: On selection primary interval only, maximize marked return%-0.5*minute drawdown%; require >=5 closed trades and valid accounting, else retain declared first geometry/horizon/threshold and mark insufficient. Stable grid tie.
protocol.no_expiry: Forecast horizon does not liquidate. TP/SL exits only; end marks include hypothetical liquidation costs and are separate from realized P&L.
protocol.execution_limit: Historical bid/ask and depth unavailable. Assumed per-side spread/slippage combined friction; price-touch signal replay, not verified executable fills.
protocol.calibration_limit: Native temperature fitted on separate calibration dates before test, later than selection dates; selection results are development diagnostics, not out-of-time calibration validation.
protocol.historical_status: Repeated historical project dates. Temporal test for this strategy protocol, not project-wide untouched or prospective evidence.
